=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- File: tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py
  Location: lines 1235-1244 (the `_run_intake` test fixture)
  Issue: the fixture now uses `payload.get(...)` for `source_kind`, `source_repo`, and `issue_number`, but the third access in the same comprehension (`pull_requests: [{"number": payload.get("issue_number")}]`) silently swallows a missing issue_number as `None`. A test that intends to exercise an autofix_failure report on the wrong PR number will then attach `null` to every run fixture and the rest of the test will quietly misbehave. Failing closed would surface the bug instead of papering over it.
  Suggested minimal fix: when a fixture would attach `null` for the issue number, raise from the fixture (or fall back to a sentinel) so the test surface is the missing key, not the resulting `null` PR.
  Estimated lines changed: 2-4
  HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2
